title: Tiny, cute hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon envelope -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='28' fill='#ff5a5a'/>
  <!-- envelope panel highlights -->
  <path d='M50 10 C60 12 72 22 74 38 C72 54 60 64 50 66 Z' fill='#ff8a8a'/>
  <path d='M50 10 C40 12 28 22 26 38 C28 54 40 64 50 66 Z' fill='#ff3d3d'/>
  <path d='M50 10 C54 11 62 20 62 38 C62 56 54 65 50 66 Z' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- bottom opening -->
  <path d='M38 62 Q50 70 62 62 L58 66 Q50 72 42 66 Z' fill='#e02b2b'/>
  <!-- ropes -->
  <line x1='42' y1='66' x2='45' y2='80' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='66' x2='55' y2='80' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='50' y2='80' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='42' y='80' width='16' height='11' rx='2' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <rect x='42' y='80' width='16' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#ffc766'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='83' x2='46' y2='91' stroke='#c47f22' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='83' x2='50' y2='91' stroke='#c47f22' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='83' x2='54' y2='91' stroke='#c47f22' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <!-- tiny flame glow in basket -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='85' rx='2.2' ry='2.6' fill='#fff2a8'/>
  <!-- little sun highlight -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#fff0b0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
